scenario: [LFAC.2.5.1]: the reassertion tolerance bound is INCLUSIVE: values are equal iff `|delta| <= tolerance`, so a change of exactly `tolerance` IS suppressed. PATH: libds's `slots_equal` (rete/wm_rete.c). Pin: `x: Float mutable tolerance 0.5`, then three asserts on one key — 1.0 establishes the fact and fires; 1.5 is a delta of EXACTLY the bound and must be suppressed, so the rule does NOT re-fire; 2.1 is a delta of 1.1 from the live value and must go through. Two firings, not three. The middle step is the whole fixture: a strict bound gives three. NB this pins the WORKING-MEMORY discipline (no new activation), not emission — a suppressed reassertion still emits FACT_ASSERT per [NFCT.5.4] / [RFCS.6.7], so an event-kind assertion could not tell the two apart.
